arguments.question: For the 63-session NVDA, MU and QQQ comparison, assess only dated macro/financial-condition inputs that can transmit to semiconductor demand or growth-equity valuation: Fed policy/rates, broad equity and credit context. Use the registered Fed/rate/market sources, distinguish facts from transmission inferences, and identify what macro evidence would change the relative assessment. Stop after the latest Fed communication and available series/benchmark observations; do not infer a rate-path consensus.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether a common rates/liquidity or macro-demand regime could dominate company-specific catalysts versus QQQ.
